name: Maitoko Yuri
source:
“What? Got a problem?
This school isn't strict about attendance anyway.”

A girl living on the top floor of a luxury high-rise in Advent City. She rose to quick success through day trading.

A hard worker, but somewhat argumentative. Has a weakness for brand-name items and spends her free time shopping.

She finds little appeal in school life and seems to keep her attendance to the bare minimum.

Class: Realist
Reality-Altering Ability: Jack-in-the-Box — an ability that manifests expensive items, with power that increases in proportion to their value.
